topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Just got the news—my apartment building is switching to condos. The idea of it all is a bit much. I guess now I'll have to start looking at the fine print, understanding what this means for my lease, and figuring out if I can even afford to buy my unit. There's so much to consider, like what this change could do to the community we've built here. Everyone's talking about it in the hallways, and it feels like no one really knows what's coming next. All I can think is, I need to sit down with a calculator and maybe a lawyer. Hoping for the best, but the unknowns are piling up.
